title.vi: Sắc lệnh Khu vực được bảo vệ năm 2017
title.th: คำสั่งสถานที่ที่ได้รับการคุ้มครอง พ.ศ. 2560

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-88-2017-PROTECTED-PLACES-ORDER-2017.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Protected Places Order, 2017 and shall commence on the date it is made.

The place specified in the first column of the Schedule hereto, which is more particularly described in the plan specified in the second column thereof deposited in the office of the Surveyor-General, is hereby declared to be a protected place for the purposes of the Act. Authority

The authority specified in the third column of the Schedule hereto is from whom permission to enter that protected place is to be received.

SCHEDULE (paragraphs 2 and 3) Place Plan Number Authority Buildings and areas, GT 16000 lTU Director of Narcotics Pusat Al-Islah, Control Bureau Narcotics Control Bureau, Kampung Kerakas Payau, Kupang, Tutong. Dated this 15th. day of Zulhijjah, 1438 Hijriah corresponding to the 7th. day of September, 2017.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA SERI KERNA DATO SERI SETIA (DR.) HAJI AWANG ABU BAKAR BIN HAJI APONG Minister of Home Affairs, Brunei Darussalam. Dicetak oleh Jabatan Pcrcctakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga 655.00
